outcomes: This document specifies the requirements for the SIA CLI (`apps/cli`). The CLI provides a command-line interface for developers to interact with the SIA platform from their terminal.

requirements.text: WHEN running `sia login` THEN the CLI SHALL open a browser for authentication
WHEN authentication succeeds THEN the CLI SHALL store the token securely
WHEN running `sia logout` THEN the CLI SHALL remove stored credentials
WHEN running `sia job create` THEN the CLI SHALL prompt for job details
WHEN running `sia job list` THEN the CLI SHALL display jobs in a table
WHEN running `sia job status <id>` THEN the CLI SHALL show job details and logs
WHEN running `sia config set` THEN the CLI SHALL update configuration
WHEN running `sia config get` THEN the CLI SHALL display current settings
WHEN no configuration exists THEN the CLI SHALL use sensible defaults
